agents_runtime_sync_pending_idx.name: agents_runtime_sync_pending_idx
agents_runtime_sync_pending_idx.where: "agents"."provision_status" = 'ready' and "agents"."openclaw_id" is not null and "agents"."workspace_path" is not null and "agents"."runtime_sync_version" > "agents"."runtime_synced_version"

channel_turns_external_message_uq.name: channel_turns_external_message_uq
channel_turns_external_message_uq.where: "channel_turns"."connection_id" is not null and "channel_turns"."external_message_id" is not null

etl_runs_terminal_shape_check.name: etl_runs_terminal_shape_check
etl_runs_terminal_shape_check.value: ("etl_runs"."status" = 'running' and "etl_runs"."finished_at" is null) or ("etl_runs"."status" in ('completed', 'failed') and "etl_runs"."finished_at" is not null)

sessions_channel_peer_uq.name: sessions_channel_peer_uq
sessions_channel_peer_uq.where: "sessions"."channel_connection_id" is not null and "sessions"."channel_peer_fingerprint" is not null

sessions_channel_conversation_uq.name: sessions_channel_conversation_uq
sessions_channel_conversation_uq.where: "sessions"."channel_connection_id" is not null and "sessions"."channel_conversation_fingerprint" is not null

triggers_pending_occurrence_claim_shape_.name: triggers_pending_occurrence_claim_shape_check
triggers_pending_occurrence_claim_shape_.value: "triggers"."pending_occurrence_id" is not null or "triggers"."pending_occurrence_claim_id" is null
